IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Saturday 7 November

Seas: 1 to 2 metres.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 60% chance of showers.

Sunday 8 November
Winds: Westerly 10 to 15 knots shifting southeasterly below 10 knots in the late afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy.

Monday 9 November
Winds: Variable about 10 knots becoming east to northeasterly 15 to 20 knots in the early afternoon then tending north to northeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy.

Tuesday 10 November
Winds: Variable about 10 knots becoming south to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots during the afternoon then shifting westerly below 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Mostly sunny.

Wednesday 11 November
Winds: Westerly below 10 knots tending southwesterly 15 to 20 knots during the morning.
Seas: Below 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres during the afternoon.
Weather: Partly cloudy.
IDT12420.synoptic: A cold southwesterly wind flows over the State today as a high approaches from the west. The high pressure system is expected to move overhead Tasmania on Sunday, drifting away to the southeast from Monday. A trough is expected to move over from the west on Tuesday evening, closely followed by a ridge on Wednesday.
